vulnerability.name: USN-8004-2
vulnerability.description: USN-8004-1 fixed vulnerabilities in FreeRDP. The update for CVE-2026-23533 introduced a regression. This update fixes the problem.  We apologize for the inconvenience.  Original advisory details:  Kim Dong Han discovered that FreeRDP did not correctly validate the size of certain variables, which could cause a buffer overflow. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.

statements.status_notes: USN-8004-1 introduced a regression in FreeRDP Available with Ubuntu Pro.
